title: R4 西西弗斯标度律：T(4I) − 3T(2I) + 2T(I) = 0（lin⊥lin 稳态 T_z 对光强线性）
derivation: k_BT = c·ħΩ²/|δ| + O(E_rec) at |δ| ≫ Γ and low saturation: at one detuning T is linear in the intensity, so T(4I) − 3T(2I) + 2T(I) = 0 for the steady states of three scenes that differ in the intensity alone. Judged against 10 % of T(4I) once the requirements hold in all three results.

conditions.what: δ from the cycle’s line in the trap / Γ
largest excited population in the lowest light-shift potential, at I, 2I, 4I
the lowest light-shift potential’s modulation over E_rec, at I, 2I, 4I
Ω_osc τ_p, at I, 2I, 4I: oscillations in the light’s wells between two pumpings
pumping times over the run, at I, 2I, 4I
photons scattered over the run, at I, 2I, 4I
(ω_z/Ω_osc)² at I: the tweezer against the oscillation in the light’s wells
4ħω_z/k_B (µK): T̄ of every member must stay above it
κ = δ_LS(0)/U₀ (the line’s shift over the cloud is κk_BT)
u from the scenes (relative to T(4I))

requirements: classical: k_BT ≥ 4ħω on every axis over the window, in every member
steady: T̄ over the window’s two halves equal within twice their standard errors, in every member
